text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan isn't answering her phone. 
While searching for her—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: Where are you heading off to?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Machan is going to look at the ocean. 
To calm her heart with the blue scenery, 
and relax listening to the sound of the 
waves..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm going to... talk with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Concerned, I decided to accompany her, 
but... Aston Machan seems utterly 
exhausted from consecutive races. I should 
reconsider her future schedule.
